comments.body: Do I use this to dismantle a ship? or do I need the NC Item to do so?

comments.author: Montador
comments.body: The name is misleading. No, it doesn't dismantle your ship. It adds armor and/or used to add a special skill onto your ship. You need to NC item to dismantle a ship.
